overview.description: The Cambria Global EW 2 ETF (GEQ) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in large cap equity. The fund provides diversified exposure to global equities through an actively managed portfolio concentrated on large-cap companies. It offered initial investors a way to diversify taxable holdings via a 351 exchange. GEQ was launched on Jun 9, 2026 and is issued by Cambria.
